result.issue_summary: The selected Gurgaon store had one late delivery among 120 eligible orders. The measured late percentage was 0.833333%, below the approved 15% action threshold. The affected customer received everything and reported limited inconvenience. Close this review without human work.

impact.rationale: The affected customer reported a small delay, confirmed receipt of everything, and asked why it was late. The completed-order record supports eventual delivery. The reviewed evidence does not indicate serious consequences or an important blocked goal.

findings.text: The sole late order was completed after its original checkout promise. The checkout promise and latest promise agree, so a revised ETA does not change the classification. The supplied policy comparison places the measured late percentage below the action threshold.

The affected customer said the biscuits and soap arrived shortly after the promise and that everything was received. A separate customer's positive review concerns another order; it is neither another delay complaint nor evidence that the affected order was on time.

The late order had packing, post-packing assignment wait and travel durations below their respective fixture thresholds. It therefore falls in the residual 'other' category, which identifies no root cause. Assignment-pattern evidence is not applicable here, rather than missing or defective.

alternatives.explanation: Elapsed time before packing or the combined end-to-end timeline may explain the promise miss without any measured stage exceeding its threshold. This remains a timing hypothesis, not evidence of understaffing, dispatch failure or a defective promise.
gaps: The timeline does not establish why packing began when it did or whether that timing was avoidable.
The operational cause of the residual delay remains unverified. That uncertainty does not undermine the supplied denominator, confirmed lateness or below-threshold policy outcome.
The reviewed customer statements support limited inconvenience, not a comprehensive assessment of every customer's experience.
result.withholding_reason: The reliable supplied comparison is 0.833333% late against a 15% action threshold. The affected delivery was completed, and its customer report supports ordinary inconvenience without a credible serious-harm or blocked-goal exception. The policy therefore calls for closure. An unexplained minor miss alone does not justify further human diagnostics, staffing changes or pilot preparation.
